== Notes ==
* Unlike [[Sundering Weapon]], this skill causes [[Armor penetration#Bonus armor penetration|bonus armor penetration]], and stacks with [[Strength]] and armor penetrating attacks.
* The [[holy damage]] caused by this spell is not [[Armor-ignoring damage|armor ignoring]].
* Heroes do not know how to use this skill effectively. They will seemingly prioritize party members with melee weapons that are not yet enchanted with this spell, but can otherwise also cast this on party members who are not even attacking.

== Trivia ==
* This spell uses the [[Protection Prayers]] skill animation and sound.
